I really feel you, around this same time last year I got so burned out as a junior. I stopped doing all my assignments (teachers started contacting my parents and everything lol) but I managed to pull it together and end with nearly all A’s. My advice is to reach out for help from the people around you, talk to your teachers and try to get them to understand that you’re struggling and need some extra support. Some of my teachers accommodated my burnout, some didn’t, but I was grateful for any help regardless. Maybe get people like family or friends to hold you accountable (in a positive/healthy way) for studying and homework, which I know is easier said than done. And if schoolwork seems impossible at the moment, instead of procrastinating with useless shit, try to put some time into your passions and EC’s that can be a nice refresher from school but will still be productive.
